title: No Travel Origin, APPR, Controllable, Cancellation Code FUEL (ANF), Cash
description:
A single-leg domestic flight was cancelled for a controllable reason: cancellation code FUEL (ANF), fuel shortage. The customer stayed at the origin airport and didn't travel. Checks that DDS finds No Travel Origin when the only flight is cancelled, uses the cancellation code (FUEL) for eligibility, classes it as controllable, and applies the APPR No Travel Origin rules: CAD 400 flat compensation plus a refund.
